raw_response:
I will mostly do what has kept my harvest steady before. I have farmed 35 years, so I do not like making big changes on 10.1 mu. Wheat and maize are still my main food-and-cash fields, and I will keep most land in that wheat-maize rotation because with well water I can manage it better. Cotton takes more watching and more picking, so with only 2 people at home I will not put too much land into it. I will leave 8.1 mu in wheat-maize and 2 mu in cotton. For fertilizer, I would rather spend a bit more than let the crop go hungry, because losing yield hurts more than wasting a little bag fertilizer. I will use improved or hybrid seed where I have seen others nearby get better stands and fuller ears or bolls. For wheat I will put the main fertilizer under before sowing, water about 3 times if the season is normal, and spray 2 times. For maize I will use hybrid seed, give it more nitrogen than wheat, water about 2 times, and spray 2 times. For cotton I will keep it on the smaller piece, fertilize enough to hold bolls, water about 3 times, and spray more often because insects are always a worry there. I will rotary till most fields because it is quicker and cheaper for my size.
